# Task

The design space around the CacheFlex kernels: an L2 whose ways
convert individually to scratchpad (the geometry is searched), the
kernel family of cacheflex_kernel (text, searched), and a partition
decided after deployment (a provisioned set, exercised by an oracle in
this file). The evaluator is layered: a kernel is measured as a curve
over capacity once per kernel text, the co-runners once per run, and
the partition is a node over curves. Three fidelity levels, promoted
by archive quantiles. The chiacache library and the gem5 nodes are
named as the task needs them; none ships with chiALU.
